combination: Static value = unchanged manual-v4 value + round(100 * learned outcome prediction). Risk unchanged; terminal and draw scores unchanged.
training: Only zero-initialized linear neuron is fitted; manual network is never trained or altered.
eligibility: Both validation and temporal-test equal-game MSE must be strictly below the training-fitted constant baseline; all technical verification must pass. This is a declared filter, not an independent test of final playing-engine selection.
opponent: same Kingsrow9015 instance if still healthy; capture actual PID/hash at start
startCondition: After completion and audit of frozen 72-game confirmation; before local18:45 to leave time for bounded exploratory run and final documentation.
stop: No new games after deadline. Preserve any interruptions. No automatic retries, weight adjustment or model promotion.
limits: No paired manual-v4 control on these three openings; no causal claim for learned contribution.
Outcome predictor may duplicate material signals already in manual evaluation.
Scale100 is a fixed manual hypothesis, not learned calibration.
Six games are exploratory; no general superiority claim.
If offline filter fails or checks/resources/time are insufficient, do not run games and preserve rejected experiment.
